name: Mixed Connective Tissue Disease
definition: Overlap autoimmune connective-tissue disease associated with anti-U1 RNP antibodies and features of lupus, systemic sclerosis and inflammatory myopathy.

investigations.principle: Autoantibodies and organ-directed cardiopulmonary testing are central.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Treatment depends on dominant organ involvement.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Rakta/Snayu/Mamsa systemic phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Overlap autoimmune connective-tissue disease associated with anti-U1 RNP antibodies and features of lupus, systemic sclerosis and inflammatory myopathy.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
